format: JavaScript (ES Modules with TypeScript typings via ts module)
description: This file is a script for analyzing plugin extension boundaries in a codebase using TypeScript and Node.js. It collects, classifies, and compares source files related to extension plugins, enforcing import rules and generating inventory reports.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory of extension plugin SDK boundary violations for a specific mode, returning sorted entries.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads baseline expected inventory data from associated JSON files for a given mode.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventory entries.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the boundary check process, outputs results in JSON or human-readable format, compares against baseline, and returns exit status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script, sets process exit code.
